messages:
Marta (Recruiter): Heads-up: new engineering manager starts next Monday. Hiring manager asked for a compact "first 10 days" checklist plus a short 30/60/90 paragraph to include in the offer pack. Can People Ops/DevEx help?

Priya: I can draft a very short checklist that managers can paste into a welcome email. Keep it one page: 1) Day-by-day setup, 2) who to ping for fast access, 3) 30/60/90 bullets.

Jordan (IT): Note: manager laptop lead time ~3 business days. If Recruiter flags as "start ASAP" we can try a pre-provisioned spare. Also we need full name + personal email to create org account.

Sam (DevEx): I'll add quick commands to get repo access and local dev env bootstrapped. Also willing to be the on-call buddy contact for week one.

Priya: Draft below (plaintext). Please keep edits inline.

```
Pre-start (before day 1):
- HR paperwork & benefits enrollment link (People Ops)
- Laptop order + laptop shipping preference (IT)
- Add to Slack + company calendar invites (People Ops)

Day 1 AM:
- 30-min welcome with hiring manager (intro + expectations) (Manager)
- Team 15-min round-robin intros (Manager)
- Laptop SSO login + MFA setup (IT)

Day 1 PM:
- Access checklist: GitHub org, JIRA, CI (Circle/GitHub Actions), Datadog, Redwood Console (Manager/Sam/Jordan)
- Schedule recurring 1:1s & send first 1:1 agenda (Manager)

Days 2-5:
- Product overview + architecture walkthrough (Tech Lead)
```
